title: A call to retreat
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: “And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him.” This means that He created you to be in His presence, to commune with Him, and to follow His guidance. He…
body: “And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him.” This means that He created you to be in His presence, to commune with Him, and to follow His guidance. He carries your burdens because He loves you and understands the struggles you face.

Just as eating improperly cooked food can cause discomfort, a believer who does not dwell in the secret place will find it challenging to feel fulfilled and at peace. Outside of His protection, you may endure hardships.

Miseries are revealed in the secret place, direction is provided there, and God’s presence is evident in a life that is hidden in that sacred space. The intensity of your intimacy with Him should not wane, even by a fraction; it is expected that you either maintain that warmth or strive to deepen it.

You may have reduced the time you spend communicating with Him because you are busy covering up distractions or engaging in unimportant tasks. What work could be more important than your friendship with Him? You have forgotten the life you can lead by obeying His instructions.

These instructions can only be found in the secret place where you are called to fulfill your obligations. You may be someone who visits the secret place only when you need something, but it’s time to return to the place you once left behind.
This is a call to retreat!

title: Willingness and zeal
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Having understood the pattern of men whom God has transformed from their previous ways of life, you will notice peculiar similarities among them all. These…
body: Having understood the pattern of men whom God has transformed from their previous ways of life, you will notice peculiar similarities among them all. These attributes helped them stand out and achieve a greater purpose that we continue to emulate and learn from until Christ returns.

God created you out of the abundance of His love because what is man that He is mindful of him? He didn’t create you as a robot to control with a remote. Instead, He gave you a mind and soul that can choose to yield a willing heart.

These two key attributes are willingness and zeal. These men were already successful and known for their work, which was fueled by the passion they put into it. This makes it easier for them to follow the Lord’s bidding.

God seeks your willingness and readiness to yield to His will and to conform to His instructions as He redirects your path according to His desires. He wants a heart-like fertile soil where His seed can germinate. However, on what ground has that seed been scattered?
Picture a plastered compound or a tiled floor—what can grow or germinate on such a surface?

When Esau first married from the Gentile nations, one might think he did not fully understand his identity. Even after hearing Isaac’s instructions to Jacob, he intentionally chose to marry more women from the nations God had commanded them not to associate with.

With such a stony and unwilling heart, could he have been a covenant bearer? With that ignorant mindset, would the Lord desire him? The Lord desires that you break down the walls of unwillingness and rigidity.
You can be vulnerable without fear of judgment because, with Him, there is room for growth. Unwillingness is a barrier that can keep you outside of God’s covenant for you.
Now is the perfect time for God to work in your life while you are still young and strong. Allow the Holy Spirit to lead you, and He will guide you in the right direction.

title: Identity crisis
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Just with observing the disciples one could tell that these ones have been with Jesus. Your identity comes from the inside and reveals on the outside, not like a…
body: Just with observing the disciples one could tell that these ones have been with Jesus. Your identity comes from the inside and reveals on the outside, not like a chameleon that takes the color of his environment.
Abiding regularly in his presence with time, you begin to look like him, with the same mind, thought, behavior and likeness. You in the world means the son of God is present.
Identity crisis begins when we cannot trace you to where you come from. Well, some children don’t look like their parents physically but if their genes are also different, then there is a problem.
Don’t be the kingdom problem!
You are an identity of God!
You are not a chameleon!

title: The gospel is enough
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: All you need for life is the gospel; it is enough, with nothing else required.
body: All you need for life is the gospel; it is enough, with nothing else required.
The constant guilt of sin and the tendency to fall back into sin indicate that you need to fully accept the gospel, with nothing added.
If you suddenly lose your peace, even though you are physically doing fine, the good news of the gospel is what you truly need.
You require a companion who listens and offers better answers than friends and family, accept the gospel beloved.
Addiction cannot thrive where the gospel is deeply rooted and embraced. Accept Jesus as your Lord and Savior.
The best you can make of your life is what He can do with it, which is always better, as long as you obey and surrender at Calvary. He is ready to accept you, no matter your situation.
Are you ready to surrender?

title: Be extra
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: It isn’t today the world becomes competitive, that anyone with extra is considered unique and meet for the Masters(God) use.
body: It isn’t today the world becomes competitive, that anyone with extra is considered unique and meet for the Masters(God) use.
The extra for Joseph was the consciousness of God even when he was gifted and had all in Potiphar’s house.
The extra for the five virgins was the additional extra oil they took, meaning a life was in them that no other had.
The extra for the three Hebrews was that they would not conform even in the sight of death(fire).
The extra for Mary, mother of Jesus, was that she was espoused to Joseph and a virgin.
You have to be extra if indeed you perceive the call of God upon you. God will not readjust his Word for you to live as you please.
Be extra!

title: The height of servanthood
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: The height of your servanthood is the level of your usability. Read again!
body: The height of your servanthood is the level of your usability. Read again!
This is so that you won’t be a boss here; you would hold the sickle and harvest with many others.
I mean, you would go out, like out, from one individual to another, house to house, gathering more harvesters. Japheth is enlarged and shem’s tent is enough to accommodate all.
Servanthood requires service. Even when you don’t submit to God in your service to him, you will serve where the yoke is heavier and more difficult.
Get saved!
Come serve!
You can be useful!

title: Continuity in faith
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Don’t be surprised when I say the funniest thing anyone could choose to do is to affirm to grow in Christ.
body: Don’t be surprised when I say the funniest thing anyone could choose to do is to affirm to grow in Christ.
Spoken words aren’t our reality but the Word is. The spoken Words of God are simple enough for everyone willing to grow.
Consistency for a start is good, at least for a proper preparation into a deeper reality, but continuity in faith is the main growth.
While consistency develops routines, habits, and character, continuity in faith shapes our identity and life, and it is always accompanied by a witnessing spirit.
To grow in Christ is to be continuous in faith.

title: Wait
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: It’s usually a virtue for a leader to be patient, especially one who the Lord will be trusting with many lives.
body: It’s usually a virtue for a leader to be patient, especially one who the Lord will be trusting with many lives.
Anyone holding on to the purpose of God is a leader. His influence will not start when he reaches a position.
The path, process, and progress must have thoroughly groomed him to be patient.
But the generation that wants to lead now wants to have success, whether in ministry or life, as fast as possible.
He cannot wait in place of prayer, he needs revelations instead of the Word, he wants it all almost immediately. It’s a pandemic!
God is calling you to stay longer!
To wait!
And to save from your current position.

title: No middle ground
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: “Your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and her god,” Naomi said.
body: “Your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and her god,” Naomi said.
This is a gentle reminder that, when a person turns away from the righteous path, they do not drift into neutrality.
They return to something, the old ways, old idols, old securities. There is no middle ground at all.
Oprah must have thought within herself, “It makes no sense to stay. Waiting longer will only waste my years. Everything is gone, and my service has not paid off.” And so, she turned back.
The very end of her story according to the scripture.
But to turn back or to compromise is not a small step away, it is a return to the very god you once left behind.
Faithfulness is not measured by convenience but by continual intimacy with Him.
Stay with him. Remain faithful.

title: Sit quietly
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Let’s have a conversation that is personal and unique to each of us.
body: Let’s have a conversation that is personal and unique to each of us.
Sitting quietly doesn’t make anyone unproductive or lazy, the issue arises only when doing nothing becomes a habit.
Sitting quietly with the Word of God is a journey towards being rooted in Christ.
After the training, teaching, sermons, and rebukes, what comes next?
It’s not about jumping into action or launching out when you haven’t yet been deeply rooted in your faith.
It is about being with the Lord first before purpose.
Find a place where you can sit quietly. I mean a comfortable space where you can calmly sit, because what makes a man is what is received and has worked within him.

title: Love is reason to stay
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: The woman said: “Thy daughter-in-law, which loveth thee…”
body: The woman said: “Thy daughter-in-law, which loveth thee…”
Little wonder Orpah could not risk staying any longer with her mother-in-law. She didn’t realize that love was enough reason to stay.
To love the Lord is to stay with Him.
To stay with Him is to be obedient to everything He asks you to do.
The reward of Obedience is not about the beautiful life you envision alone, but about fulfilling God’s mandate.
Ruth didn’t stay out of a desire to be part of a covenant generation, she stayed because of her love for the God of Israel.
In a generation that chooses everything else but loving God through action, Be different!
To serve is to stay in: love, action, and service even when it doesn’t seem to pay.

title: The plus life
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: One thing salvation brings to every Christian is a plus life, a life that goes beyond business, education, and personal accomplishments.
body: One thing salvation brings to every Christian is a plus life, a life that goes beyond business, education, and personal accomplishments.
A plus life is one that challenges a stuffy, sinful establishment.
A plus life is an infectious, Spirit-filled life, one where others cannot help but be influenced by the life of Christ in you.
A plus life is a life that is free, liberal, and unrestrained in pointing men to the Cross, the Cross that has the power to transform lives.
For some of the disciples, living a plus life meant becoming fishers of men.
What does your “plus life” look like for the gospel?

title: A life that becomes yours
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: As a Christian, I’ve discovered an amazing truth , a life you give to God truly becomes yours.
body: As a Christian, I’ve discovered an amazing truth , a life you give to God truly becomes yours.

A life lived in the world belongs to the world because you constantly struggle to choose your own will. Every form of sin is pursued to its fullest, and the soul gradually becomes destroyed, broken beyond recognition.
The saddest part is that instead of seeing the possibility of restoration, you begin to focus on the damage, the shattered pieces, the condemnation, and the self-pity.
But salvation changes everything. Totally.
What salvation truly does is make your life yours again, so you can freely choose God’s will.
Have a wonderful week ahead.

title: Contentment in a few words
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: This is contentment in a few words:
body: This is contentment in a few words:
• It is keeping your focus on the Prize while pursuing the limitless. Christ is the Prize!
• It is turning away from glamorous opportunities that do not glorify God.
• It is knowing and believing that Christ is enough, and His grace is sufficient.
• It is laying everything, no matter how abundant, at His feet in total surrender.
• It is rejecting complacency and laziness while staying active under His divine leadership.
• It is abiding in His presence and following His leading, even as He grants you authority over your possessions. That, too, is contentment.
Can you also share what contentment means to you?

title: Do you know Him?
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Relationship begins with a spark of love that can be intoxicating. It is that season when you just met a new friend and their presence alone is enough to keep the…
body: Relationship begins with a spark of love that can be intoxicating. It is that season when you just met a new friend and their presence alone is enough to keep the heart at rest, safe, and alive.

With time, it becomes progressive, and the place of knowing hits harder. This stage can either mar or make the relationship if both friends are not intentional. Yet God desires more than this typical form of friendship.
Knowing God is more than knowing letters and stories of the Bible just to argue or show off knowledge. The true measure is whether the Word convicts, transforms, and illuminates Christ through you.

Knowing God is also more than lengthy hours of prayer. It is about the content of those prayers, whether they are only around self, and whether there is space for Him to speak while you listen quietly.

The place of knowing will put you on your knees to seek His mind for the people. It will strip away selfish desires to submit you fully to His will. It will cut away excesses daily, unveil Christ through His Word, and devote your life to the harvest.
Can you say that you know Him?

title: The adequate Christ
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: You will never be used of God if you constantly look at your inadequacy. Looking unto Jesus is what the scriptures recommend. You’re useless, yes, accept the…
body: You will never be used of God if you constantly look at your inadequacy. Looking unto Jesus is what the scriptures recommend. You’re useless, yes, accept the thought that you’re. If a man tells you that you’re miserable, never argue. You know you’re more miserable than he thought.

There is one truth that he fails to tell you, you’re more adequate than he thinks. The Adequate Christ dwells in you. Men-pleasers falls into the hideout of false humility. They please men, not God. They think of what people will think of them, say of them, think of them. They never carry out what God tells them, in the name of humility — a false one, that has root in the thinking of inadequacy.

You can never make yourself into what God wants you to be, but you can trust Him to make you into what He wants of you. As long as they look at the serpent biting them, and think of their incapability to overcome, they died. When they looked up to Jesus, they live.

We are able to go up, Joshua and Caleb declared. Not because of self sufficiency, but a revelation of the God of Jacob that they carry within them. You uncircumcised philistine, David declared, I will give your heads for the birds to eat. Upon what premise? I come to you in the name of the Lord.

If He was told that He is inadequate, yes, it’s true. Is Christ adequate, more than. The gospel is enough to save. Don’t allow the thinking of inadequacy allow you add what God does not want there to it.

Your dressing is okay, don’t allow the thinking of inadequacy make you to be like a god. When Eve ate the fruit, the world lament. Tattoo is as result of inadequacy thinking. Let me add this to it. What is not even found among those called unbelievers.
It’s adequate, if God is pleased with it.
You can’t make yourself into what God want to make of you. You can trust him, oh frail man, to make you into what he want to make you to be.
Grace, peace and mercy.

title: Never look at your inadequacy
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Never look at your inadequacy, it’s suicidal.
body: Never look at your inadequacy, it’s suicidal.
A careful reflection at the fall of man shows this in clarity. Satan uses what psychologist can refer to as reverse psychology, making you feel less of who you are.
Eve saw her inadequacy and that makes her desire what will make her adequate. The battle was first won in the mind. The desire to make it up makes her eat the fruit.
Let’s leave theology for a while, you know that psychological thoughts of twisting the undiluted word to sound pleasing, is it not the silent whispers of “I must be adequate and well okay?”
That same thoughts is capable of dressing you in short gowns, short skirts and revealing blouse widely open to attract its prey, just to make it up.
You don’t improve what Christ has already made adequate.

title: The yellow flower
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: There is this beautiful, colorful yellow flower I often admire whenever I pass by its tree. I would take pictures of it and slow down each time, because I can never…
body: There is this beautiful, colorful yellow flower I often admire whenever I pass by its tree. I would take pictures of it and slow down each time, because I can never seem to satisfy my sight enough.

It stands just a little taller than I am. One day, I jumped up and plucked some of its flowers so I could keep them with me for as long as I wanted. But after a short while, their yellow glow began to fade, and the petals slowly fell.

Then it dawned on me: the best, most beautiful and blissful flower I loved could only remain that way as long as it stayed connected to where it feeds. Once disconnected, it is only a matter of time before it loses everything I once admired about it.
In the same way, what has always sustained a man is where he feeds from and what he feeds on. Guard it carefully.

title: The entrance of the Word
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: It is as though the entrance of the Word that established our faith is no longer considered sufficient to break a man free from all the things of the old creature.
body: It is as though the entrance of the Word that established our faith is no longer considered sufficient to break a man free from all the things of the old creature.
The centurion said, “Speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.”
The woman said within herself, “If I may but touch His garment, I shall be made whole.”
The two blind men cried out, “Son of David, have mercy on us.”

Yet now we are burdened with reminding you of the faith that first brought you to salvation, rather than going together to save others, because needs have always been the focus and doing His will secondary.
Come up hither, you of little faith. The entrance of the Word is powerful enough to sustain a man through His work.

title: Seeking the means, not the Source
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: This is the fate of men who would rather seek the means than have the Source, because they have been blinded into thinking the Source is slack and burdensome. They…
body: This is the fate of men who would rather seek the means than have the Source, because they have been blinded into thinking the Source is slack and burdensome. They would rather do many other things that place heavier yokes upon them like sacrifice, offerings, worship, service, and pleasing men.

They seek teachers who can give their itching ears exactly the words that comfort, bless, and encourage them, and prophets whom they believe can appease God on their behalf, approve of their wicked deeds, and clothe their ego in majesty.

Ahab once told King Jehoshaphat that he hated a particular prophet, Micaiah, because he would never prophesy good concerning him. What else would a man expect to hear from the Lord when his wife had stirred up all kinds of wickedness in his heart?
The Source will not give you the world, instead, you must obediently seek the Kingdom first, and then all things will be added to you.
He will convict you of sin, causing you to walk in the righteousness of God.
You do not even need a means, because He has already poured out His Spirit.

title: A responsible child
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: A child who has been taught the use of the Sword is one who can stand and fight in the days and seasons when battles arise.
body: A child who has been taught the use of the Sword is one who can stand and fight in the days and seasons when battles arise.
A child who has been given the shield of faith as a defense against attacks, whether near or far, is one who is truly protected from evil.
A child who knows that the battle is not fought by human strength, but by God, who provides every needed weapon per time, is a true warrior.
A child who carries God’s testimonies in their heart as a guide possesses the greatest inheritance, an asset worth far more than this passing world.
A child who can testify of the goodness of God is one through whom the Scriptures are fulfilled, silencing and avenging the enemy.
A child brought up in the ways of the Lord is one who can both walk with God and work for Him, establishing His Kingdom in the hearts of others.

As children of God, everything you truly need has already been prepared by the One who supplies all our needs. At this Student Mission Conference, what He gives may not be money, fame, clothes, or shoes, but it will be exactly what you need for the season He has called you into.
know that you will become a responsible child.

title: He never left
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: To depend on how you feel is to lose God completely after a long time. Your feelings are useful but not to know if God still exists especially around those silent…
body: To depend on how you feel is to lose God completely after a long time. Your feelings are useful but not to know if God still exists especially around those silent periods.
Knowing comes from continuous and relentless study of His person through his Word. No other way to know him is dependable than this.
The period that you don’t hear from him, he is already speaking only that you want a magnificent appearance like the burning bush before you to know he is there.
Constant dependance on your feelings to validate his presence and communication is to continually feel alone.
Stay devoted. He never left!

title: The forgotten sword
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: One of the reasons devotion is so, so important is that, at first, you can become so familiar with it that you fail to recognise the power it holds.
body: One of the reasons devotion is so, so important is that, at first, you can become so familiar with it that you fail to recognise the power it holds.
Imagine a soldier with all his armour: the one for his head, shoulder, chest, elbow, hand, waist, knee, and feet. All these are to ensure his physical safety, but he forgets one thing.
So, he leaves for battle without his sword. He knows how useful it is, but he is confident that even with his bare hands and skills, he can fight.

For Goliath, despite all his armour, it was possible to strike him at the most vulnerable part of his body. He was a skillful warrior, but he knew not what made him vulnerable until the stone struck him.
As for you, you cannot afford to be like the soldier or Goliath, leaving a hole in the wall for all manners of rubbish to find their way in.
You are most vulnerable when you neglect your devotion before God. Even a powerful soldier will fall if, unconsciously, he has forgotten or departed from his devotion.
Not immediately, but it is only a matter of time before he becomes a dishonoured vessel.
Being vulnerable is a threat to you. Watch!

title: Chasing validation
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: I know you too well to not recognise how you think and react. I also know how easily your emotions can be triggered by something, whether real or imagined. It’s a…
body: I know you too well to not recognise how you think and react. I also know how easily your emotions can be triggered by something, whether real or imagined. It’s a constant struggle that robs you of the joy of the Lord.

As your sister, I see how badly you want to be validated by strangers or anyone, just as long as you are applauded. There’s nothing wrong with being applauded when necessary, but that desperate desire for validation from an illusion is exactly what I have to talk about today.

There’s practically no standard of living you cannot be made to feel inadequate about on the Internet. Everything here is scripted perfectly for you to lose your mind, especially when the algorithm keeps feeding you the very things strong enough to make you feel less.
Depression. Mood swings. Anxiety. Sadness. Unending chaotic mind.
The strangers here are a crowd, and if you stand for truth and righteousness, you could be the first to be sacrificed for a thief to be set free. Ask Jesus. You cannot trust the crowd.
You were not bothered about your neat, affordable clothes until you met younger people on this space who never repeat luxury outfits.
You were not bothered about your melanin skin until you noticed that everyone here seemed to have light skin.
You were not bothered about your affordable Android phone until you saw your friends flaunting the latest iOS behind mirrors.
If only you knew what the Lord has said about you and the real-life assignments He has prepared for you, you would have stopped chasing illusions and their validation.
My dear, the Lord needs you to minister before Him.

title: Until you meet the cross
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Until Jesus happens to you, I mean until you encounter the cross, You have never experience freedom. My dear, as long as one is clouded by sin, freedom means…
body: Until Jesus happens to you, I mean until you encounter the cross, You have never experience freedom. My dear, as long as one is clouded by sin, freedom means fleeting pleasures.
I write to you as someone who knows what fleeting pleasures do to your mind. You may never even want to be free because you may not yet recognise what has you bound.
When your mind, body, and soul become attached to things that offer temporary satisfaction, the thought of being free from them may not even appeal to you.

Fleeting pleasures can make you a slave to your desires. What begins as something you choose to do then become something you struggle to stop doing. Eventually, what you once thought you had control over begins to control you.
No damage is beyond what the Father can mend, and you still have a chance to come to Him today.
You won’t miss those things when you meet the cross. Trust me.

title: Why you need Jesus
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: You don’t need Jesus to be rich and wealthy.
body: You don’t need Jesus to be rich and wealthy.
The world has sufficient teachers to help you achieve that. Get knowledge.
You don’t need Jesus to be successful in Life.
We have too many successful men and women who don’t have Jesus. Get access.
But you definitely need Jesus for eternal life and that is why he came to reconcile us back to the father. Reach out, Abba Father!
Until you know why you seek him, you cannot have a fulfilled life.
Simple!

title: Don't settle for consultation
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: You will not know the advantage you have as you renew your mind daily with the Word until you wake up one day to settle for consultation.
body: You will not know the advantage you have as you renew your mind daily with the Word until you wake up one day to settle for consultation.
You are permitted to Holies of holy but it’s not enough except there is a third party involved or you are the third party yourself.
Trust me Jesus love you like that to come back to your father.
You still don’t understand consultation right?
That constant dependance on all other things except the Creator of it is consultation for me.
You see those wise men of Babylon who could not tell the kings dream or interpret it thought they were more intelligent until the invisible things cannot be revealed to them.
Just one day, one will wake up and observe they are smarter and can choose better than God served through objects.
Another day, he would be awake and realize all of the extraordinary are just fable and they don’t exist.
Some moments, all things came to being from something gradually and not created.
Object are best as intermeidiary to hear from God after all he created them to be worshipped too.
There are mysteries he cannot get and the missing books can only provide them.
Provided they serve the look like of what God give freely is consultation.
You have an advantage to come daily, sanctified, consecrated and renewed.
Don’t settle for less my love.

title: Find your way back
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: It was the only begotten Son that was hung on the cross but it was you who sin.
body: It was the only begotten Son that was hung on the cross but it was you who sin.
It’s the Same him who keeps sheparding you but it is you who would always run back leaving the flocks.
He swallowed death in victory but it is you who desire everlasting death.
He gave himself as sacrifice once and for all but it is you who doesn’t believe if it doesn’t come with a cost of blood shedding.
He was at a time a mere man so that you can once again be son with him but it is who would settle to be anything less than a son.
It is also him who labor with yoke no man has ever bear but it is you who prefer the labor and yoke of this world alone.
If you needed even more, he have given unto you already.
Don’t go further, find your way back to his arm!

title: Disciplined for what?
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: What if your struggle with discipline is not really about discipline, but about what you see?
body: What if your struggle with discipline is not really about discipline, but about what you see?
I think the word discipline is underrated, and it isn’t a virtue many of us have been able to sustain over a long time.
You think it’s limited to structure, firm decisions, and choices about the work we do.
If the latter is the focus, then discipline might be questioned from time to time.
These things can all change, and when they do, this limited understanding of discipline can become a burden instead of a relief.
To actually make it simple, discipline is best achieved when you know the end result.
Maybe not fully, but having some knowledge of it helps you stay on the mission that leads to the vision.
Joseph knew this, and years of slavery and imprisonment couldn’t take away or disrupt his discipline.
Maybe you are not struggling with discipline, you have just lost sight of where you are going.
Perhaps it’s time to look beyond the immediate demands of discipline and ask yourself what you are being disciplined for.
Reflect and have an amazing week.

title: Just a reminder
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Just a reminder today.
body: Just a reminder today.
The appetite the world gives you is not a type you can literally deal with naturally. It’s builds up to an extent that it is capable to destroy such body.
If it’s gluttony, I think health wisely there are sufficient sickness to deal with till ones organ can no longer withstand the effects.
If it’s sex, I think no man or woman except a robot can satisfy or match your energy.
The progressive knowledge of sex preserved between couples has been uncontrollably enjoyed with different partners.
If it’s other addiction I won’t mention all, it ensure that it consume you so much that control over your body is no longer with you.
You said you want freedom, the same freedom is hijacked to allow you freely to be doomed.
And the amazing thing is that, it’s going to be enjoyment to you for as long as it destroys you enough to never return to the same father willing to pick the pieces into wholeness.
My love, this is just a reminder like I said.
Ire oooo.

title: Stop personalising experience
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Lifes journeys differs, seasons and timeline also differs, even every individual body differ in response to treatment, disease and recovery depending on it’s…
body: Lifes journeys differs, seasons and timeline also differs, even every individual body differ in response to treatment, disease and recovery depending on it’s lifestyle or genetic.
Having this knowledge, I still wonder how you think you have to experience some negative circumstances because its common around.
Exception cannot be the rule but until you experience it, it can be your rule.
Abraham was known for Faith, not all named Abraham has that same faith that birth covenant.
After him, everyone encounter and journey was different though their love for God was constant.
Why do explain this far?
Child labor is painful, you should not be fearful due to others experience of it, you can be prepared.
We have bad individual and other people perspective about a gender should not be your judgement. God still have men!
A skill is hard not because you have love doing it, learnt, practice, and growing in it, you then conclude it’s hard from others experience.
Moses does not have to be sold to a strang land, Joseph can.
Jesus does not have to have his head cut off, John the Baptist can.
Isaac will not waste year to get a wife, Jacob can.
Peter can deny Jesus and be prayed for, Judas cannot but go on to commit suicide.
So what exactly is the need to personalize evil circumstances? You will experience a different life but I know you have an advantage.
You have a Father, get closer.
Stop personalizing experience.

title: Your body, His temple
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: What characterizes the temple of God?
body: What characterizes the temple of God?
· God Himself hallowed it.
· His name is there forever and is to be passed down from generation to generation.
· His eyes and His heart shall also be there perpetually.
· It is a holy place that only a sanctified priest can enter.
· It is a place of fellowship and assignment.
The question is, can you characterize your body, your temple, as this?

title: Fed on awful things
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Some awful things you think are normal are not. You have simply fed yourself with them for so long that the healthy ones now look like suffering.
body: Some awful things you think are normal are not. You have simply fed yourself with them for so long that the healthy ones now look like suffering.
Currently, trying to enlighten people about skipping breakfast might sound stupid because, all their lives, they have believed that breakfast is the best meal of the day.
Someone who does not sit with the Scriptures but relies on hearsay whenever conversations about faith arise thinks they are healthy, too.
Another believes so much in traditional practices, diabolical rituals, and the earthly worship of creatures because, somewhere along the line, they have fed their consciousness with nothing else.

Even a calm, peaceful, and righteous life can look fake and feel like bondage to someone who has known nothing but chaos all their life. If it is not a disaster with a terrible outcome, then it must be hell.
You cannot know how much of what you have been fed is awful until you begin to question everything, even the things you have always believed to be true, with a supposedly enlightened mind.
I pray for you, your veils be burnt away. Amen.

title: What is your Baal?
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: What a lovely Father, who doesn’t give up on His children!
body: What a lovely Father, who doesn’t give up on His children!
God is indeed faithful in giving us His Word forever, so that our focus remains straight both in sight and heart.
Baal is an idol perceived to be sovereign above all, simply because that is as far as the veiled eye can see.
Even if it meant having to reconstruct it from time to time, at least, it is all that there is.
As long as it exists not only physically but also remains locked in the heart, he will always have a place to return to.
Bring him to a far better place, and he would still choose an option he can fall back on.
You cannot fully understand him if you have never held a once-dear Baal in your heart, along with all that it offers,
even though it is only a counterfeit of the devotion he is capable of rendering.
He could have been whole if he had left nothing behind, burnt his bridges, and dared to walk in his waters alone.
Sadly, with Baal in sight and in the heart, he cannot submit.
What is your Baal?

title: Your stronghold
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: The easiest way to strategically overcome any man is to first pull down his stronghold. That is why, in wars against the Israelites, one of the first things their…
body: The easiest way to strategically overcome any man is to first pull down his stronghold. That is why, in wars against the Israelites, one of the first things their enemies attacked to take their lands was to destroy the walls.

Once the wall was pulled down and destroyed, they could enter from the left, right, and center without being cornered in one spot and easily defeated by the Israelites. Even when we know it was ultimately in vain because it was the Lord who had taught their hands to war, at least they could think they had a chance.
So, let’s talk about you today.
Why are you without defense? What has brought down your stronghold?
One of the benefits of daily coming into God’s presence and constant abiding is that you build a stronghold.
Beloved, be on your guard!

title: Not minding my business
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: I am very big on this word as context matters a lot.
body: I am very big on this word as context matters a lot.
It is okay not to be inquisitive about people’s lives, especially when they are not ready to share.
Publicly announcing or congratulating someone on an achievement they have not announced or permitted you to share is an overstepping of boundaries.
Investigating people’s affairs and trying by all means to get information about them, especially when it has nothing to do with you, is simply not minding your business.
Yes it isnt.
Recently, that sentence has been abused so much that everyone just says it without thinking twice about what they actually mean by it.
“Mind your business” is not a sentence to excuse bad character, evil behaviour towards others, irresponsibility, or immorality.
One of the ways love is expressed is by constantly allowing people to see themselves in the light of the life they claim to have within them or follow.
Since loving you is a must, dear sister, I will also love you enough to hold you accountable without minding my business.

title: Go back to the secret place
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: I love to be your accountability partner, ensuring that you are not blown away by the wind strategically positioned around you. I can see the strategic vices for us.
body: I love to be your accountability partner, ensuring that you are not blown away by the wind strategically positioned around you. I can see the strategic vices for us.
This time is too sensitive for you not to hear the Father going around like He did in the Garden of Eden, calling, “Where are you?” One thing I know for sure is that it will be difficult to hear Him.
For anyone living in Nigeria and a street boy living on social media with little to no time for personal devotion, communion and consistent fellowship with God, it is even more difficult.
I have come to realise that with this level of exposure to junk and waste from all over the place, no one can stand the test of time without eventually returning to his vomit and insanity.
Even the moments that should allow us to focus in worship have become the very moments that distract us with content and all kinds of urgency.
The noise here on earth is crazy, my beloved and you can only get it right and shut it out when you align yourself with the will of the Father for you.
Go back to His secret place and listen!

title: To and fro, going nowhere
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: How bad can things get?
body: How bad can things get?
As much as the disturbance, anxiety, contamination, different teachers, trends, controversies, and many more are sufficient to keep the people busy.

You know those plants that grow on water, especially where the water’s activity is constant? Have you ever imagined their struggle, always going to and fro? They don’t have to move far, but even at the same spot, they are continually restless.
How bad things can get usually piles up to an extent of noticeable damage, so much so that the result takes so much therapy, physically, mentally, and spiritually to make an individual healthy again.
You are always on the move, to and fro, going nowhere.
You are busy doing unproductive things as far as purpose is concerned.
You are filled with so much knowledge, except that it is always in battle with the Word of God.
With this sufficient distraction planted as a seed among the brethren, vision is already impaired and life is being wasted. Hopefully, it has not gone as far as going back to the world.
Come on, go back to your vision and focus!

title: Leadership without the sacrifice?
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Many who desperately desire leadership know not what it entails.
body: Many who desperately desire leadership know not what it entails.
Does being a servant of all sound like a joke to you?
Does taking upon oneself the pain of others sound like a walk in the park?
Does dying for the needs of others sound like a smooth death?
Can you have deep compassion for the oppressed, poor, and afflicted? Can you survive being an enemy to the system that benefits from their problems?
Do you mind being crucified for your good works?
Can you live with betrayals from family and friends?
Look at yourself who desire leadership, except the sacrifices.

title: It's messy out there
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: I know for sure that God is loving indeed especially in how much his laws can protect us from mess and problems. The ways that he saves us from all kinds of panic…
body: I know for sure that God is loving indeed especially in how much his laws can protect us from mess and problems. The ways that he saves us from all kinds of panic and destruction is something to be grateful for.
In a world that gaslight you into thinking you are foolish for being sane and living for God, you can dare to be different and be in liberty from the consequences of the actions of sin.
It’s messy out there!

title: The vessel carrying the light
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: As someone who is very inquisitive, I love where I can ask questions and get answers, or where we can simply ponder on a subject together until we figure it out. It…
body: As someone who is very inquisitive, I love where I can ask questions and get answers, or where we can simply ponder on a subject together until we figure it out. It feels like a safe place for me, and I love it so much.

I was with a brother some weeks ago, and as usual, I was asking questions while he answered me. I asked a particular question whose response I would love to share because I believe it will be helpful to us all.
Let’s just go into his explanation, as you may understand it better that way. I paraphrase.
Being called light goes even deeper than the purpose it serves to others, which is what we easily see. It also means that you are visible, and that your life becomes a standard of faith to others.
And because you are visible, your own weaknesses begin to show even more because you are light, the meanness, selfishness, pride, envy, hatred, lasciviousness, variance, and so on.
But as you allow the Holy Spirit to begin His work in you, His fruit also begins to be made manifest.
It is okay to be a work in progress in the hands of the Holy Spirit and that there are things He is still working on in you.
But it is not okay to remain in your weaknesses.
Because the light that shines through you is not just about what people around you can see, it is also about what they encounter when they look at the vessel carrying that light.
Men will come to the light that shines and is life in you, but what happens when they come close enough to see the vessel?
A vessel so unkind and mean, I wonder.

title: A new heart
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: The function of the heart and its purpose have been made to lose relevance so much that it has even become a joke on us. The angels will giggle and wonder, “What is…
body: The function of the heart and its purpose have been made to lose relevance so much that it has even become a joke on us. The angels will giggle and wonder, “What is this again?” Just imagining.
The best way now to avoid taking responsibility for the flesh ruling over the body is to echo within the heart, “God is only concerned about the heart; He is less concerned about the physical.”
Immediately we are called to take responsibility as brethren, the response is dragging like generator and a disgusting look of “oversabi Christian”.
Dear beloved, this fruit that we see as one body with Christ is not found with us. It is different, and it reveals the exact thing that governs your heart.
This character and path are far from righteousness and holiness, and God would not look at such a heart except to draw it closer to repentance and salvation.
A heart that is not in alignment with the character of God needs a new heart, one that only the Holy Spirit can give.
Today is another day to come!

title: Go beyond the congregation
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: It just occurred to me that many of us don’t joke with our work with God. Being still, sitting, and just staying for a while in service can make it look like you…
body: It just occurred to me that many of us don’t joke with our work with God. Being still, sitting, and just staying for a while in service can make it look like you have lost your position as a child of God.

You do this work so much that you barely have time to shine beyond the congregational boundaries. Only the saved brethren within a structured place get to see the good works. You are never fully available like Jesus was with the people.
It’s a psychological wiring that has bothered my spirit for so long, and it feels so heavy in my heart today that I need to share.
By faith, you are saved, and work flows from the abundance of love you have for God, as He works in you to will and to do of His good pleasure. Work is an act of service to God and man, done in love.

For more context, some people will say you should join a visible department in the church for visibility, so that it becomes easier to have a life partner, business partner, or whatever else. Or that you are more justified and precious to God than others because of the work you do.
This is wrong.
There is no time to be among the people. The zeal and rush to be faithful within the congregational boundaries can become so much greater than being faithful to Jesus as He has asked us to “go.”
He meant go because it will not limit you to a building, system, activity, or boundary.
It will bring you among the same people, like the Samaritan woman at the well, the sick on the street, customers, bosses, colleagues, neighbours, and so many others.
I love to serve too, as I am a worker in the church. But this particular angle needs to be talked about among my fellow youth.
Consider this.

title: Faith beyond letters
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: I was never told faith is not easy. I saw many of what faith entails through the lens of Abraham and others, but the reality is not something I imagined to be this…
body: I was never told faith is not easy. I saw many of what faith entails through the lens of Abraham and others, but the reality is not something I imagined to be this difficult.

I say difficult because I am so used to my formal self, to walking by sight, taking calculated risks, predicting my next move, having timely expectations, depending only on my work, and obediently following if it makes sense.
But faith will say,
Leave your father’s house to a land I will show you.
The Lord will provide Himself a lamb.
If our God will not save us, then we are not afraid of death.
If I do this, I will sin against God.
We refuse to defile ourselves with the king’s meal.
Wherever you go, I will follow.
I have read how your God saved you right from Egypt, and I believe He has given us to you.
If You don’t go with us, don’t take us further.
Should I pursue? Pursue and overtake!
And I have lost count… But their end is a testimony till today.
Lord, help us to not only believe faith in letters, but let it be our reality until we see You. Amen.

title: Don't be another yoke
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: All of us can be Pharisees and Sadducees in one way or another. Not in identity, but in attitude and disposition. We can become so consumed with our own interests,…
body: All of us can be Pharisees and Sadducees in one way or another. Not in identity, but in attitude and disposition. We can become so consumed with our own interests, positions, reputation and privileges that we become hypocritical about the very things we claim to stand for. Christlikeness.
The perspective of selfishness I mean is how they could be so zealous about a law whose fulfillment was standing right in front of them, yet they knew Him not. Why?

Anxiety sets in… The choicest food on their tables, being ladders to God (third party benefits), policing the people who needed help, becoming another set of “holy” slave masters, so much so that they were completely distracted even when the Savior was with them.

All these they did because they would rather settle for the process, the process that met all their needs and continually afflicted the people, just as long as every one of their own selfish needs was met.

We have quite a number of them! We have many selfish Christians who are mean, emotionally numb, wicked, evil, and unkind in their interactions with others in their environment. As long as their own needs are met, others can perish.
You are not to add more yoke to others’ loads as a child of God.
You can be rich and a good, generous person.
You can be wealthy and help others become wealthy.
You can be brilliant, intelligent, and a teacher to many.
You can be a boss and a servant leader.
You can be a husband just like Christ.
You can be a wife, a help just like the Holy Spirit.
You can be all these things and still be Christlike.
In all, don’t be another yoke or worst nightmare.
Shalom.

title: The aesthetic king
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: There is actually one thing about our modern-day “aesthetic everything” that I can relate to in the light of Scripture.
body: There is actually one thing about our modern-day “aesthetic everything” that I can relate to in the light of Scripture.
The Israelites wanted a ceremonial king like the other nations. They wanted a king because other nations had one, and it looked good. They wanted the aesthetic of it.
Remember, the other nations were jealous of Israel’s living God and how effortlessly He loved them. It was undeniable, too consistent to be false.

The children of men are usually jealous of a life that mirrors Christ because they cannot relate to the holiness and character of God, nor to the freedom that comes from access into the Holy of Holies.
To think that you are missing out is nothing but a lie, an illusion designed to lure you back to Egypt.
Missing out on what?
The constant panic and restlessness?
The addictions?
The immorality and fornication?
The drunkenness?
The scars and diseases?
And to what end?
The modern-day Christianity that aesthetically blends with the love of this world has no good end to offer, except the continuous cycle of rebellious humanity.
Repentance is possible today.
Come!

title: Light is loud
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: One thing light does is expose all things and cause darkness to disappear. This is so smooth, except that it can be chaotic sometimes.
body: One thing light does is expose all things and cause darkness to disappear. This is so smooth, except that it can be chaotic sometimes.
The chaos is not in the object of illumination but in the body being exposed. How do you describe a life called light and completely abhor all manners of ungodly character?
All the descriptions of light you know are only in letters, affirmations, and merely spoken words, a hope that is aware of the description but not a life that represents it.
Light is loud.
Not dimmed.
It is bold in a world that expects godliness to be silent.
It is not an affirmation but a reality lived.
It cannot compromise.
It is a life set on a hill as a standard of heaven to the children of men.
Stop spreading chaos as light. Consider the generations whose unholiness you are fanning. Christ is light and life.

title: Your own roots
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: A tree cannot survive by depending on another tree’s root, logically, it is not possible. If it is detached from its own root, it must die.
body: A tree cannot survive by depending on another tree’s root, logically, it is not possible. If it is detached from its own root, it must die.
A plant cannot survive by the depth of another plant. It must have its own depth to survive and stand through the years.
His Word. His love.
He gave you the latter out of the abundance of grace He has extended to you and you cannot stay alive by the root and depth of others.
No matter how mighty or great any human may be, their rootedness and walk with God can only inspire you, they can never make you deeply rooted in Christ.
Lest you are easily uprooted, sit with the Word!

title: Love that comes from knowing
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: It is usually the knowledge of His Word that brings about the love and fear of God. His Word contains His nature, law, deeds, precepts, statutes, and judgments.
body: It is usually the knowledge of His Word that brings about the love and fear of God. His Word contains His nature, law, deeds, precepts, statutes, and judgments.
I am not talking about the kind of love that comes because of all the grace you have received.
The kind that settles for crumbs rather than sit at the table as a son.
Not even the miracle-hungry kind of love. We know from the Scriptures that He is wonderful, and so we love Him in expectation of another miracle.
Daily bread nko? He provides it in a timely manner, and loving Him for bread is easy as long as it keeps coming.
Human definitions of love and fear are still shaped by sin. Without the knowledge of His Word, which can become life in us, the so-called love we know is a scam.
There is no better time to sit with His Word than now!

title: Seek Him first
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: When a man’s life is empty of the presence of God, he does everything, even fights battles except seek the God of his salvation.
body: When a man’s life is empty of the presence of God, he does everything, even fights battles except seek the God of his salvation.
You think you need another “bigger” revelation or encounter to fill the void. Not really.
You think you need more tools for warfare. Not really.
You think, Maybe if I meet a man who can tell me everything about myself, I will become a better person. Not really.
If I had experienced the kind of life others live, I would have prospered. Not really.
My friends were born with a silver spoon, so I am already at a disadvantage. Not really.
You have continually done everything except seek Him.
Seek Him first!

title: A living sacrifice
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: A sacrifice will cost you a lot, a living sacrifice will cost you even more. David said, “I will not make a sacrifice to my God if it will not cost me.” There is a…
body: A sacrifice will cost you a lot, a living sacrifice will cost you even more. David said, “I will not make a sacrifice to my God if it will not cost me.” There is a price to pay, and Jesus paid it too.
So, sacrifice comes with a cost, whether it is a thing or a person.
A life that continually dies every day is not a joke, and you have to understand that you may lose everything in this world to cleave to Jesus. Trust me, the world loves its bondage so much.
It pays to serve Jesus. I speak from my heart because the eternity He promised is worth far more than the glamour and everything this world can give.
Remember, you are co-heirs with Him.

title: Idols that do not glitter
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: A man after God’s own heart is no longer new to anyone who is a Christian. We preach so much about him, we love that he had a grateful heart, and was a skillful man.
body: A man after God’s own heart is no longer new to anyone who is a Christian. We preach so much about him, we love that he had a grateful heart, and was a skillful man.
Someone like me dreams of a day where I would be married to my David because why not? Since written words and richly written lyrics captivate my heart so much, then David must be the man .
This same man was never acquainted with idols. Not once. Never!
You see, I have observed with us that we have so many idols in our time now compared to the stone age. They are subtle. Insignificant. Not a big deal.
It is so much that we don’t have to go out around to worship these idols. We cannot survive without it. As long as the lust of the flesh is fed, even God can wait. Ha!
So I pray that the Lord open our eyes to see the idols this time, not glittering but worshipped. Amen

title: Into battle with faith
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: There is a reason why so many will not find life easy because life itself is spiritual, and battles are real, whether you are conscious of them or not.
body: There is a reason why so many will not find life easy because life itself is spiritual, and battles are real, whether you are conscious of them or not.
We are the most spoilt generation of God’s children because all power in heaven and on earth has been given to Jesus, and all you need first for battles is salvation. What a privilege!
Why battles? This is because you are a responsible child of God, and with your hands, you are being trained so that God can be glorified in you.
So, we would go into this week with faith as the armor of God and our weapon of war.
Let’s go!

title: Come back home
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Somethings are check and balance and I don’t know why it’s so difficult for you to understand, but I think that’s why God has enriched my thoughts for you.
body: Somethings are check and balance and I don’t know why it’s so difficult for you to understand, but I think that’s why God has enriched my thoughts for you.
I don’t need to learn bad things personally because I am very weak and learning from people terrible experience is the best way sometimes to jump and pass trauma. Plus the Word of God is clear.

I see you all complain about cheating partners so bad and you still go ahead to fornicate with them. My love, you can’t make them loyal and faithful to you this way. The cycle continues birthing the same worst family system many originate from.
We will not have to be saying this if Jesus is your Lord but here He is again saying, Son! Come back home, do not die labouring.
Come!

title: Count the cost of freedom
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: One thing I will not sugarcoat is my perspective of the reality you can relate to, while bringing you into one you might not know existed. And right now, it is how…
body: One thing I will not sugarcoat is my perspective of the reality you can relate to, while bringing you into one you might not know existed. And right now, it is how pleasurable freedom can feel to humans.
You want freedom, but the consequences of every action are not something you would usually think about or be ready to take responsibility for. Count the cost.
(She whispers)
What freedom meant to me was enjoying many amazing worldly things, everything I thought I couldn’t do under instructions that felt like bondage.

I was not told that I would not recover easily from a man I was emotionally connected to, whom I constantly desired and with whom I also sinned with my body. I was scared he would sin against my body, which was why I tried every means to keep my man. (Not my husband, please.)

I was not even told that these alcohols were problems dressed in sourness and bitterness. I still had to buy them with my hard-earned money while destroying my temple, all in the name of enjoying “the life of my head.” Trust my flesh, I never knew.

I was not well informed that all these fruits (trauma, hatred, lustful thirst, etc.) I would bear as consequences of my actions would eventually be revealed in my body. Some information sounded too extreme, and I never knew they were this serious. By the time I discovered the reality, I was already damaged and addicted.
Sin shaped my definition of freedom, and I knew it not.
How much better would it have been if the freedom I chose was not chaotic, but liberating? The history and memories I carry will now be a war against my flesh.
Say no more! Quit excuses!
From ages past, grace has continually been extended to the guilty and sinful.
Repent. Come to Christ, who saves today.

title: For the girl behind the camera
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: I have this deep compassion for young girls, especially teenagers who have phones, and what they talk about almost all the time on their posts is the opposite sex.
body: I have this deep compassion for young girls, especially teenagers who have phones, and what they talk about almost all the time on their posts is the opposite sex.
She is dancing, twisting her waist in front of the camera, with captions like this attached:
“omo God forbid man wey no sabi talk sorry ooo”
“I no even remember when last I kiss ooo”
“Since them born me, I never go date before”
“Na guy wey no dey cheat dey suffer pass for relationship”
“If your man is not giving you money, trash am”
“Fine girl, body is tea and even 9-5ier cannot afford”

I feel this great urge to save her from this unhealthy obsession with intimacy, not with God. If the only season in life you have for God and yourself is still centered around someone who cannot fill the void and emptiness in you, you lose!
And winning is knowing God, being intimate with Him in His Word, fervent prayers, and living a life that glorifies Him.
I also know that the best form of compassion, concern, and love is praying for you. I pray that God, your Father, draws you closer to Himself so that you can experience His salvation.
Jesus loves you.

title: The seed of fear
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: I have observed how strategic the vices of the enemy are across the Scriptures, and it cannot be overlooked. Tell me about how a seed is planted and the life it is…
body: I have observed how strategic the vices of the enemy are across the Scriptures, and it cannot be overlooked. Tell me about how a seed is planted and the life it is planted in is about to be wasted, except that seed is discovered early.
For the Israelites, it was fear. It was so bad that everything they feared would happen to them completely consumed them. I mean, they were utterly destroyed if not for God’s lovingkindness.
With the seed of fear planted, it will just get a seat to sip tea or go to sleep because such a life is already defeated, except you know what seed was planted.

It is even more surprising when Nehemiah got a prophecy to flee into the temple just to kill him. If he had not been aware that fear was upon him, he would not have been able to discern the authenticity of the word.
Dear wonderful believers, you cannot be defeated again by his vices. Fear and worries will come, but lay them at the Master’s feet and go and rest.
Yes! I said it. Go and rest so that you can hear His Word.
With fear, sin is inevitable.

title: Pay attention to details
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Gisting is sweet when it comes with the complete details, and these guys don’t understand. I wish I could sit you down and lecture you on how, when information is…
body: Gisting is sweet when it comes with the complete details, and these guys don’t understand. I wish I could sit you down and lecture you on how, when information is given, you get it in full. Common!

I have plenty brothers, and we like to discuss so much about technology, nations, facts, sex, science, innovations, history, movies (we don’t do love movies here ), and so many more. I enjoy their company so much that I have no homie friend except one. But these guys are so poor at gisting.

As someone who is very inquisitive about everything and asks so many questions, I can tell you for free that you need to focus on details. I mean genuine attention to details that benefit you when you are trying to gain knowledge.

You brought information to me, and when I ask you a few questions, you say you don’t know. How? Were you not supposed to get the details alongside the information you brought? They still go on to make me feel like an amebo.
I am actually speaking in line with you and the Scriptures here, not my brothers.
If you are just starting out with Scriptures, be inquisitive about who God is first,
Him as a Father,
Him as Love,
And the essentials of faith in Him, the Trinity, Salvation, Sanctification, Redemption, Discipleship, Eternity, and so much more.
You need to pay attention to details on matters that are beneficial to you first, especially those that help you become deeply rooted in your faith.
The next time I hear, “Where in Africa is the Garden of Eden located?” or “Jesus Christ was an African man,” me and you will fight.
Sit with the Word more. Learn. Be focused. Pay attention to details.

title: There is still space in the ark
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: I have observed how culture has conditioned our minds over the years, and every day I wish the sound mind we ought to have were a reality. But sadly, it isn’t.
body: I have observed how culture has conditioned our minds over the years, and every day I wish the sound mind we ought to have were a reality. But sadly, it isn’t.

Don’t say you are not part of this conditioning because, subconsciously, some of the knowledge, environments, and information we never properly processed are the very things we hold on to. Sometimes, they are extreme.

You know about the tactics of darkness and how they operate. Witches oooo, wizard ooo, you know about their dark powers and how mighty they are. You have watched movies where the so-called “power of God” wrestles with these dark powers. They are real, no doubt.

In the pursuit of being smarter and more enlightened, you have learned about the universe, the stars, the sun, the moon, the seasons, crystal readings, and many other orisirisi. I mean, you can account for almost every element of creation except the Creator. The only man that is a fable is Jesus Christ.

You embrace all of these and also well-versed in them, yet this same Jesus Christ we keep introducing to you is the One you find difficult to believe. Even faith as small as a mustard seed is enough, yet you would rather place your faith in the universe.
The yoke you have chosen to carry by yourself is far heavier than the yoke of faith in Christ Jesus that has been freely offered to you by grace.
Think about it.
There is still space in this Ark.
Come!

title: Freedom at the exodus
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Freedom comes with a lot of fear on the other side because the unknown that one would face is something to be afraid of.
body: Freedom comes with a lot of fear on the other side because the unknown that one would face is something to be afraid of.
For a normal man, give him food as long as it is certain and he knows exactly what the next meal will be. He need no faith.
For a normal woman, give her all the material of adornment on a liveless body, it’s enough and she needs no inner disposition because coming out of freedom will stripe her of her supposed idols.

As long as the parents are safe in slavery and it’s assured the children have a arm to run to, there is no need to be free. A child just wants a home with a joyous family even if the home is just a show to him.
This faith that you must have, the striping that must be done, the idols that should be taken away and the perfect home a child should desired can be established at the exodus.
You can’t afford to miss this! The Lord awaits your deliverance.

title: Rapture is nearer
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: It is almost becoming agreeable that Christ will not come again because, after more than 2,000 years, He has still not appeared. For a God who reveals prophecies…
body: It is almost becoming agreeable that Christ will not come again because, after more than 2,000 years, He has still not appeared. For a God who reveals prophecies that have all come to pass, with only a few yet to be fulfilled, it is expected that man may begin to forget.

This is the time when many are weary and their faith is fading because fear has been used as a tool to steal their alertness and devotion. Men no longer watch carefully lest they go astray, neither do they hold firmly to the testimony of Christ to know what they must do to stand without losing their salvation. Yet, the one who comes to steal, kill, and destroy is never weary and never loses focus in striking. But you are different.

Disturbances, disorders, pandemics, famines, alarming events, and confusion are only a few of the things believers will witness and recognize as signs that the end is near, yet not immediate. When men focus only on these things, anxiety, worry, fear, complaints, murmuring, vain words, regrets, and depression become their coping mechanisms. They become more logical than spiritual.

Man now turns to governments for help, hoping they can silence wars and commotions so that peace may reign. Yet the same government, hijacked by the spirit of the antichrist, will persecute believers, lay hands on them, deliver them into prisons, interrogate them, and even kill them for His name’s sake, and it shall be a testimony unto them.
With all the resources, raw materials, intellectuals, spiritual leaders, knowledge, and exposure across the world, peace is still absent. Come on, you are not surprised!

The Scriptures have already revealed all these things so that you may remain aware and watchful, that even if He comes like a thief in the night or as in the days of Noah, you will already be in the ark. God’s people must respond differently because they are not in darkness.
And what should your response be?

And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh… and then shall they see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
Rapture is nearer now than ever before!!!

title: Oh, you slothful one
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: The children of men are moving toward their eternity with seriousness and focus. Some have even convinced themselves that hell will be enjoyable because their…
body: The children of men are moving toward their eternity with seriousness and focus. Some have even convinced themselves that hell will be enjoyable because their favorites will be there.
Yet, the most unserious person about their heavenly race is you, who calls yourself a “Christian.”
Slothful.
Unfocused.
Careless.
Not watchful.
You are empowered yet you waste it.
You go out hunting, fishing, laboring…
but you leave the meat to rot because you are too tired to prepare it.
You catch the fish, yet you do not serve it.
You earn, yet you carelessly leave the money on the shelf, forgotten.
Oh, you slothful one.
This journey you have taken is yielding no profit, neither to you nor to God. This is not how the apostles in the Scriptures manifested their empowerment.
This carelessness, lack of urgency, it must stop.

title: “Lord, help me”
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: ”The Lord help me” is one of the most abused prayer request of many persons who hate to take responsibility for their actions.
body: ”The Lord help me” is one of the most abused prayer request of many persons who hate to take responsibility for their actions.
Help was already made available by God after that His Son resurrected and his spirit was poured out to all men. Is there another help you mean aside from this?
A struggling lustful man will say, Lord help me with my lust instead of say that the desires of flesh should be completely dead.
A thief will say that he needs help from God instead of saying that the desires of the lust of the world be consumed with fire.
That desperate rich man also needs help from God except that the Lord shouldn’t take his riches.
The grace of God is always available to save all men, you just need to be sincere in asking God what help you need him to do.

title: The disease under the clothing
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: My lust, desires for pleasure and profits of the world. It became the very disease under my clothing I secretly nursed. It is not an open wound yet but as I scratch…
body: My lust, desires for pleasure and profits of the world. It became the very disease under my clothing I secretly nursed. It is not an open wound yet but as I scratch sometimes, it soothes my flesh that I want to continue in it. So I continue.

I am careful it doesn’t ruin my reputation in public and it scent doesn’t chase men away from me. This men that expected more from me and look up to me, I cannot lose my integrity for a disease I know I have control over.
I have a solid structure to keep everything on checks. This is you.
It actually takes more work and faith to be an unbeliever with yokes mighty, strong and without any help. You must be tired.
Jesus said, His yoke is easy, light, and you can lean on Him. Even with a faith as small as a mustard seed, come to the throne of grace.

title: What is truly boring
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: Christianity is not boring” is often defended by Christians who are drawn into their own selfish interests.
body: Christianity is not boring” is often defended by Christians who are drawn into their own selfish interests.

The vibe, clamour, goosebumps, emotions, falling, tongues on command, the worldliness in our mode of worship, lifeless words, fashion parade, dancing, and all of that in a place are not what make Christianity unboring.
You know what is truly boring?
The absence of the presence of God, men who cannot serve as Christ did, women who have not chosen the one needful thing, children who cannot perfect praise, and the people who cannot dominate.

title: The uncircumcised flesh
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: The difference between Satan and a son of God is that a son submits to the Word of God, else he is just another Satan walking around.
body: The difference between Satan and a son of God is that a son submits to the Word of God, else he is just another Satan walking around.
It is so funny that the picture of the enemy we all grew up to know is an entity wearing black or red, with a face and sounds very scary. The enemy truly is the flesh uncircumcised.
With this uncircumcised flesh, the best man you have seen without this same Jesus Christ we continue to preach is still a ticking bomb waiting to explode at any time.
Explosion is suicidal or death and grace is still available at the throne of grace.

title: Shift our desires
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: I desire the position of a man after God’s heart, how he was chosen from his brethren and how God prepared him from when he was a shepherd.
body: I desire the position of a man after God’s heart, how he was chosen from his brethren and how God prepared him from when he was a shepherd.
I desire how mighty a man in battle he was, the Philistine and others knew in his days there is a God who can rule the affairs of men effortlessly.
I desire his bravery and confidence in Yahweh in the ways that he seeks guidance at all times and declares the counsel of God.
I desire wrongly.
My desires should have been an enlarged heart where God dwells and a life completely strip of self or reputation as I behold him.
Oh Lord, shift our desires.

title: Bring down the high places
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: God called Abraham His friend.
body: God called Abraham His friend.
He chose Jacob and loved him.
He called Moses to bring His people out, and Joshua to lead them into the Promised Land.
He said David was a man after His own heart.
Even Elijah was jealous for the Lord of Hosts.
One thing is consistent with these men: they never gave a high place to idols.
Idols today are no longer carved from stone, wood, or gold yet you know how easily you become attached to these high places, exalting them above God.
These high places must be brought down.

title: Seeds
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: One of the most powerful things one would likely not pay attention to is seeds, especially the unwanted ones. You know how the most beautiful fruits are selected…
body: One of the most powerful things one would likely not pay attention to is seeds, especially the unwanted ones. You know how the most beautiful fruits are selected from among the ugly ones? We do not usually do that with seeds.

All the works of the flesh are seeds. If not replaced by the fruit of the Spirit can make a vessel unfit for use, delayed in the incubator, continuously broken by the potter to achieve a perfect shape, and sometimes shielded from others to prevent contamination.
The Lord will not use a vessel He has not prepared. And the exchange of seeds for fruit is not done in isolation, but through pruning by His Word and devotion to God.
There are many seeds dispersed into a man’s life. May the Holy Spirit never cease to uproot the ones that do not serve the purpose of God, as you continue in your devotion to Him. Amen.

title: The harp at hand
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: I once had a harp given to me by a precious one, to learn, to play, and to make music with. With it, I sang to God as I worshiped and shepherded my father’s sheep.
body: I once had a harp given to me by a precious one, to learn, to play, and to make music with. With it, I sang to God as I worshiped and shepherded my father’s sheep.
Through that harp, the words of Yahweh stored in my heart became songs. My mother loved to hear them. They gladdened my father’s heart, and even my siblings could not escape the joy it carried.
Friends in the neighborhood were drawn to the sound, even their parents would invite me over just to listen, to hear the wondrous works of the God of Israel.
Many tales by moonlight ended in worship and praise. My fingers often hurt from plucking the strings, yet I paid no mind, because it was with joy that I played.
Now, as I look back with gratitude and with greater responsibility, I understand this truth, “one does not need a bigger tool when the harp currently at hand is too small to be used.”
You are not confused. You know what to do.

title: Serving God His way
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: It is very peculiar how many people desire to serve God only in the so-called “big ways.” Wanting to serve is not wrong, it reveals a heart that has tasted love and…
body: It is very peculiar how many people desire to serve God only in the so-called “big ways.” Wanting to serve is not wrong, it reveals a heart that has tasted love and longs to give back.

The big ways are always admirable, winning 3,000 souls in one sermon, carrying a handkerchief that heals the sick, possessing a presence that convicts sinners, speaking with a voice that creation obeys, wielding influence that visibly expands the Kingdom. The list is endless.
A man who is loved can indeed love back sincerely and zealously. Yet even that love must be guided, because the One who first loved him desires to be loved His way.
So the Father may say,
“I will not give you a sword like your brothers on the warfront. Take this harp instead. Sit here with Me. Play. Stay.”

To a child, that instruction feels strange. It neither looks like service nor impact. And because the child believes love is proven only by serving as he wishes, he assumes the Father would not be pleased with this service.
You are not confused. Ask the father.

title: Can the Lord bear witness to you?
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: A man’s life will contradict a pattern when he becomes selfish and disconnected from his source. Such a man serves God only when and where the benefits are…
body: A man’s life will contradict a pattern when he becomes selfish and disconnected from his source. Such a man serves God only when and where the benefits are measurable, when obedience can be calculated, quantified, and turned into personal gain. His devotion is conditional, not surrendered.

He use authority as though there is no Judge higher than himself, no throne before which he must eventually give an account. The rising culture of “anyhowness”, the norms, careless way people live and lead is clear evidence of this disconnection from God.

Closeness to the control center is nothing more than a heart that looks like Christ. It is seen in the selflessness Jesus radiated toward the people, and in His reverence, obedience, and faithfulness to the Father. This is accountability in its purest and most powerful form.

Don’t give excuse by saying, “After all, every Christian I know does the same.” Numbers have never been God’s way since narrow is the way. The only increase we want to pursue is righteousness, and the true growth of the body of Christ.
Can the Lord bear witness to you, as He did to Samuel?

title: From object of sin to servant
author: Agboola Abigail
excerpt: With the sufficient supply given by God, it is expected that his needs are met. Yet he wants more, his desires become insatiable. Living to satisfy those desires,…
body: With the sufficient supply given by God, it is expected that his needs are met. Yet he wants more, his desires become insatiable. Living to satisfy those desires, he begins to search for a rock shell.
Even if there were a rock shell, God would not create him to find a piece of material that cannot be used for anything, especially when His will is concerned.

For you, before Madam Potiphar ever tried to strip you naked, you must have been walking through the empire already naked, your six-pack built to trap every maiden, without exception, not even ants or butterflies searching for sweetness will be spared.

For you, food is merely another substance required by the body. Even if it can corrupt your body, trade your birthright, and make you desire to become like God, it does not matter. All stones must be turned into bread.
But with discipline, you are no longer a mere object of sin, you become a servant positioned close to the control center.
